derivation: exact union of the plan projections of every face of the part, from its LDraw decimals, in integer millionths of an LDU; outer rings counter-clockwise in (x, z), holes clockwise. Coordinates with up to six decimal places, and crossings of plan-axis edges, are exact; roundedLdu is the largest distance any coordinate moved to its millionth (longer products of subfile matrices, and crossings of oblique edges, which are rationals no decimal unit holds)
